rules: Ratings are collected ONLY from HLTV statistics pages with the retrieval UTC recorded; each row names its exact window (trailing 90 days ending at retrieval) and the maps-played denominator.
A player row is publishable only with >= 40 maps in the window; below that it is 'unavailable', not interpolated or estimated.

HLTV robots.txt disallows several /stats query-parameter URLs (startDate/endDate/maps filters); collection must respect robots.txt and, where a filtered window URL is disallowed, the window is implemented by page selection and dated retrieval instead of query parameters.
Ratings are ANALYSIS INPUTS, never facts: they are third-party performance aggregates and must not be presented as the reason any market price is 'wrong'.
No rating is published until it satisfies every rule above; this file ships empty by policy.

note: Defined 2026-09-24 as the prerequisite for any future player-rating coverage (README coverage work). Empty by policy: no compliant collection has run yet.
